arguments.value: Novo Integrated Sciences Inc. (NVOS) and Harvest Gold Farms Inc. (HGF) agreed to form a joint venture to develop, manage, and operate medicinal farming projects involving hemp and cannabis cash crops. The agreement says the joint venture company, to be named Novo Earth Therapeutics Inc. in a Canadian jurisdiction, will handle the project’s liabilities and operations. NVOS will lead development, management, sales, financial records, reporting, financing arrangements, facilities planning, and product purchase contracts, while HGF will provide land, approvals, farming expertise, crop production, and staffing. HGF must make available at least 7,000 acres and provide related land documentation. NVOS is to pay HGF 30% of net company income annually beginning 12 months after the first full 12-month revenue period, buy product at cost plus 5%, and may issue 2 million NVOS common shares if the company reaches $25 million in annual net profit. Profit distributions are described as 70% to NVOS and 30% to HGF, subject to the agreement’s audited review process. The initial term is five years from the effective date, with possible renewal by agreement. The source does not state a governing law.
